ticker_notes.NU: 拉美金融服務不足，成長期長

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 認為，在大家追逐已大漲的股票時，$MELI 股價仍接近 2021 年高點，但營收年化規模已增至約 400 億美元。巴西電商僅佔零售約 12%，金融服務也不足，他認為 $MELI 和 $NU 只靠服務拉丁美洲既有需求，就還有多年成長空間。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay argues $MELI is still trading near its 2021 highs even though revenue has grown to a roughly $40B annual run rate, while others chase stocks that already ran. With e-commerce only about 12% of Brazil's retail and financial services underserved, he thinks $MELI and $NU have years of growth ahead just by serving demand that already exists in Latin America.
text:
Everyone is chasing stocks that have already run while $MELI is still trading near its 2021 highs despite revenue growing to a ~$40B annual run rate. 

What also makes Latin America so interesting is consumers already have smartphones and spending power yet e-commerce in Brazil is still only ~12% of retail while financial services remain underserved.

Thats why I think $MELI and $NU have years of growth ahead without needing to expand beyond Latin America because both are building the commerce and financial infrastructure for demand that already exists.
